Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Corliss Williamson?

Corliss Williamson is 51 years old.

Where was Corliss Williamson born?

Corliss Williamson was born in Russellville, Arkansas.

When was Corliss Williamson born?

Corliss Williamson was born on December 4, 1973.

How tall is Corliss Williamson?

Corliss Williamson is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much did Corliss Williamson weigh when playing?

Corliss Williamson weighed 245 lbs (111 kg) when playing.

Is Corliss Williamson in the Hall of Fame?

Corliss Williamson is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Corliss Williamson drafted?

Corliss Williamson was drafted by Sacramento Kings, 1st round (13th pick, 13th overall), 1995 NBA Draft.

What position did Corliss Williamson play?

Small Forward and Power Forward.

When did Corliss Williamson retire?

Corliss Williamson last played in 2007.

What is Corliss Williamson's net worth?

Corliss Williamson made at least $42,673,520 playing professional basketball.

How much did Corliss Williamson make?

Corliss Williamson made $6,500,000 in 2007.

What did Corliss Williamson average?

Corliss Williamson averaged 11.1 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 1.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Corliss Williamson have?

Corliss Williamson won one championship.

What schools did Corliss Williamson attend?

Corliss Williamson attended Russellville in Russellville, Arkansas and Arkansas.

What are Corliss Williamson's nicknames?

Big Nasty is a nickname for Corliss Williamson.
